candidate.rationale: The DeepViewClone trait already requires 'res.deep_view() == self.deep_view()'. Adding the same ensures on the impl would be redundant and triggers the 'already_specified_via_trait'/verus_error. The reported stderr shows harness/import and module-visibility issues (missing DeepViewClone import, private module) that are unrelated to adding a postcondition here and should be fixed separately.
risks: Duplicating the trait-level postcondition would cause anti-vacuity / already_specified_via_trait errors.
Adding an extra clause (e.g., res.is_some() == self.is_some()) is logically implied by deep_view equality and would be redundant.
Harness errors (missing imports, private module) must be resolved independently; ignoring them may hide real verification problems.
